name: CKEditor Citation
description: Integrates the CKEditor 5 citations plugin for adding citations to content.
project_description:
This module provides functionality to add cite tags in your content with the click of a button when using CKEditor. Citation tags can be used to cite creative works such as books, music, artworks and films.

 Features 
 This module is best used for someone who needs to cite work while writing content in CKEditor on their Drupal website. This lets anyone add citation tags with the ease of just clicking a button. No need to go into the Source view and adding the cite tags manually.

The button can be clicked to open a cite tag, and the user can continue typing while in the cite tag. Then they can close the tag by clicking the button at the end of the text they wish to cite. Or they can type their full text and go back afterwards and highlight the text they wish to cite and then click the button and apply the cite tag then. Likewise, highlighting citation text that already has cite tags applied and clicking the button, will remove the cite tags on that text.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Download and enable the module 
 Once enabled, edit your desired text format in your website's Text Formats and Editors section. (admin/config/content/formats) 
 Add the Citation CKE5 icon into the "Active Toolbar" 
 Click the "Save" button 
 Back to top
